scenarios.description: Top-level CLI help renders
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js --help >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Assistant init supports force reset
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js init --force >/dev/null

scenarios.description: OpenAI onboarding succeeds in deterministic mode
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js onboard --provider openai --api-key test-key --model gpt-4.1-mini --yes --no-store-api-key >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Doctor command runs without blocking errors
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js doctor >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Config set/get roundtrip works
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js config set name UATUser >/dev/null && value=$(node ./bin/gaia.js config get name) && [[ "$value" == "UATUser" ]]

scenarios.description: Capability override is persisted and listable
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js capability set send_email confirm >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js capability list) && [[ "$listed" == *"send_email confirm"* ]] && node ./bin/gaia.js capability set send_email forbidden >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Chat creates and resumes session
scenarios.command:
out=$(printf 'hello from uat
/exit
' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat 2>&1) && session_id=$(printf '%s' "$out" | sed -n 's/^Started session: //p' | head -n1) && [[ -n "$session_id" ]] && resume=$(printf '/exit
' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat --resume last 2>&1) && [[ "$resume" == *"Resumed session: $session_id"* ]]

scenarios.description: Note/task capture and listing work
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js note --task 'UAT task capture' >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js tasks --status all) && [[ "$listed" == *"UAT task capture"* ]]

scenarios.description: Summarize and summaries commands work with local fixture
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js summarize "file://$HTML_FIXTURE" >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js summaries --last 5) && [[ "$listed" == *"UAT Summary Fixture"* ]]

scenarios.description: Plan creation and listing work
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js plan 'UAT roadmap objective' >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js plans --last 5) && [[ "$listed" == *"UAT roadmap objective"* ]]

scenarios.description: Schedule create/list/update/run-due/cancel paths are deterministic
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js schedule create --profile safe-daily --every-minutes 60 --at 2026-02-08T00:00:00Z --window-minutes 15 >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js schedule list --status all) && schedule_id=$(printf '%s' "$listed" | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && [[ -n "$schedule_id" ]] && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule update "$schedule_id" --window-minutes 20 >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule run-due --at 2026-02-08T00:05:00Z >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule update "$schedule_id" --at 2026-02-08T00:00:00Z >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule run-due --at 2026-02-08T00:05:00Z >/dev/null && skip=$(node ./bin/gaia.js traces --type schedule_skip --last 1) && [[ "$skip" == *"schedule_skip"* ]] && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule cancel "$schedule_id" >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Reminder create/list/pause/resume/snooze/dismiss paths are deterministic
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js reminder create --every-minutes 60 --at 2026-02-08T00:00:00Z 'UAT reminder' >/dev/null && listed=$(node ./bin/gaia.js reminder list --status all) && reminder_id=$(printf '%s' "$listed" | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && [[ -n "$reminder_id" ]] && node ./bin/gaia.js reminder pause "$reminder_id" >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js reminder resume "$reminder_id" --at 2026-02-08T00:00:00Z >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js reminder snooze "$reminder_id" --until 2026-02-08T00:05:00Z >/dev/null && node ./bin/gaia.js schedule run-due --at 2026-02-08T00:05:00Z >/dev/null && traces=$(node ./bin/gaia.js traces --type reminder_run --last 1) && [[ "$traces" == *"reminder_run"* ]] && node ./bin/gaia.js reminder dismiss "$reminder_id" >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Structured traces are queryable
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js traces --last 5) && [[ "$out" == *"|"* ]]

scenarios.description: Autopilot dry-run preview works
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js autopilot run --profile safe-daily --dry-run 2>&1) && [[ "$out" == *"Dry-run autopilot plan"* ]]

scenarios.description: Autopilot execution works and emits traces
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js autopilot run --profile safe-daily >/dev/null && traces=$(node ./bin/gaia.js traces --type autopilot_run --last 1) && [[ "$traces" == *"autopilot_run"* ]]

scenarios.description: Anthropic digital twin path responds locally
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js config set provider anthropic >/dev/null && out=$(printf 'anthropic twin check\n/exit\n' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat 2>&1) && [[ "$out" == *"[local-anthropic]"* ]]

scenarios.description: OpenAI digital twin path responds locally
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js config set provider openai >/dev/null && out=$(printf 'openai twin check\n/exit\n' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat 2>&1) && [[ "$out" == *"[local-openai]"* ]]

scenarios.description: OpenRouter digital twin path responds locally
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js config set provider openrouter >/dev/null && out=$(printf 'openrouter twin check\n/exit\n' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat 2>&1) && [[ "$out" == *"[local-openrouter]"* ]]

scenarios.description: OpenAI-Codex digital twin path responds locally
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js config set provider openai-codex >/dev/null && out=$(printf 'openai codex twin check\n/exit\n' | node ./bin/gaia.js chat 2>&1) && [[ "$out" == *"[local-openai-codex]"* ]]

scenarios.description: Auth status command path is deterministic
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js auth status 2>&1 || true) && [[ "$out" == *"No linked auth profile"* || "$out" == *"OAuth profile is ready"* ]]

scenarios.description: Auth login rejects unsupported OAuth providers
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js auth login --provider anthropic --source codex-cli --no-prompt 2>&1 || true) && [[ "$out" == *"Unsupported OAuth provider"* ]]

scenarios.description: Auth link rejects removed OpenClaw source
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js auth link --provider openai-codex --source openclaw 2>&1 || true) && [[ "$out" == *"invalid choice"* && "$out" == *"openclaw"* ]]

scenarios.description: Auth link reports missing Codex credentials
scenarios.command: out=$(node ./bin/gaia.js auth link --provider openai-codex --source codex-cli --codex-auth-path "$GAIA_ASSISTANT_HOME/missing-codex-auth.json" 2>&1 || true) && [[ "$out" == *"Codex credentials not found"* || "$out" == *"Expected auth file"* ]]

scenarios.description: Gaia run single dry-run works
scenarios.command: node ./bin/gaia.js run --mode single --dry-run --reasoning-provider openai --reasoning-model gpt-4.1-mini >/dev/null

scenarios.description: Self-evolve loop dry-run command path works
scenarios.command: GAIA_AGENT_MEMORY_DIR="$GAIA_ASSISTANT_HOME/agent-memory" python3 ./tools/agent-loop.py --config ./tools/agent-config.yml --mode single --dry-run >/dev/null
